title: Nudge training workshop
quote: Myself and a few members of my team attended a Nudge Training workshop with Martin and it was a really informative, interactive and inspiring session. The mix of theoretical and practical examples helped to focus us in on how we could apply Nudge to our work and gave us a great starting point to begin testing our ideas. Martin delivered a great session, keeping the energy up in the room and challenging us to think differently about our communications and processes. Really enjoyed it, I would recommend this course for anyone working in customer marketing and creative.
author: Graeme Newman
subject: Nudge
